name: Discipline
source:
Welcome! Club Kinther is a forbidden heaven for people with "Peculiar Tastes" to play. The moment you step foot in this place, Dane Paul thinks of hundreds of commands to make you his own pet. By being harsh sometimes, and sweet at other times, he's the best master. Don't resist him! Savor the satisfaction he gives you.

[From in-app]
